metrics.claim_denominator: deepVerification lists only claims the verifier disputed; in all exports observed to date every listed claim carried an inaccurate verdict. Read n_contradicted_claims as an absolute count of flagged claims, NOT as a share of the idea's claims. The idea's total claim count is not present in the export and cannot be inferred.

recommendation.section:
## Recommendation and Best Next Steps
Advance H-001 (IC-001, allosteric small-molecule PCSK9 inhibitor, Elo 1642.5) as primary series and H-002 (IC-002, oral macrocycle, Elo 1588.0) as backup series into Stage 1 genetic, transcriptomic, and structural validation.
